}}'''"Eris"''' is an Overseer and Vice Architect of the [[Fractsidus]] who is first mentioned during [[All That Sunlight Touches]]. Their identity remains unknown and "Eris" is a codename, although [[Luuk Herssen]] was able to discover that they run the Fractsidus' critical monetary operations in the [[New Federation]].

==Trivia==
===Etymology===
*[[wp:Eris (mythology)|Eris]] {{Lang|grc=Ἔρις}} is the Greek goddess of strife and discord. It is also the name of a [[wp:Eris (dwarf planet)|dwarf planet]].
